dataLabel: Synthetic scenario stress tests; not observed operations or online rolling evaluation
mechanisms: odd seeds: aged backlog; even seeds: arrivals over days 0-5
planSelection: Use a complete feasible default MILP plan; if absent, retain the case and report no initial plan, never substitute silently.
audit: Independently re-evaluate the unchanged initial dates against disrupted resources and actual processing durations. Never calculate operational savings from an infeasible plan.
recovery: Solve again with all realized disruptions known at planning start. This is a hindsight full-information diagnostic, not a feasible online rolling strategy or guaranteed recovery after execution.
inference: Paired variants reuse the same inputs intentionally; report counts and ranges, not independent-sample confidence intervals. Retain every case regardless of result.
